title: Custom 3D printing and design workshop
announcement:
Welcome to my 3D printing shop! I make holders and organizers for colognes, perfumes, makeup, lipstick, concealer and cosmetics. I can make a holder to fit any sized item with a circular or square base. If you don't see your specific brand or size in any of my listings, feel free to reach out to me directly! I can work with you to figure out the size of your bottle and come up with a design.

I also offer holders with mixed shapes (circular and square), mixed sizes (e.g. 5 holes at 21mm, 5 holes at 19mm and 5 holes at 15mm), mixed numbers of holes per tier/row, and multiple tier/row options (e.g. a 10 hole holder with two tiers of 5 holes, a 20 hole holder with four tiers of 5 holes, etc.) 

Just let me know your specific situation and I can make a personalized design and send you a custom listing.

Special Offer: Buy 2+ items and save 25%—discount applied automatically at checkout!
